status: SELECTED - this file is the model's default precision policy
selection_rule: the fastest evaluated config that satisfies the full-model accuracy gate (top-1 >= 0.90, top-5 >= 0.98, top-100 = 1.00 on BOTH run_prefill_check and run_teacher_forcing), ranked by trace-verified teacher-forcing decode t/s/u

measured.regime: trace-verified teacher forcing, batch 1, AIME24 chat-template reference, 100 generated tokens, best of 9 warm repeats in one build (spread 0.26 %)

lm_head_note: pinned to the values C06 resolved. lm_head_dtype/lm_head_fidelity default to null, which means 'follow the dense projection group'; naming them here makes the terminal projection explicit rather than derived
kv_cache_update_contract: paged_fill_cache takes tensors in the cache's own dtype (the layer casts them); paged_update_cache/paged_fused_update_cache take bfloat16 update tensors even when the destination cache is bfloat8_b. That is the op contract, not a policy choice
sampling_note: the split sampler consumes the logits tensor on device: a per-device local top-k over the bfloat16 vocabulary shard, an all-gather of the 4x32 candidates, then ttnn.sampling with k=1, p=0. logits_dtype is what the local top-k reads; the sampler itself exposes no dtype knob, so bfloat16 logits are the assumption it is built on (C15 measured a bfloat8_b logits tensor at 41.991 t/s/u, inside the baseline's noise)
override_note: ORNITH_PRECISION_POLICY=optimized returns the build to the pre-sweep decoder-stage policy; ORNITH_PRECISION_POLICY=fused-parity returns it to the bfloat16 floor
